title: Inazuma Cobblemon
description: Various QOL and gameplay improvements while keeping the game well balanced and optimised for the Inazuma Cobblemon server.
body:
Custom modpack for Inazuma Cobblemon Server.



Modpack adding various mods for cobblemon, specifically for the Inazuma cobblemon server. Various QOL and gameplay improvements while keeping the game well balanced and optimised for the Inazuma server.

Includes Journey's Map for navigation, with a resource pack to allow the display of pokemon for easy hunting.

Custom Recipes for uncraftable cobblemon items to encourage the making of the perfect pokemon team while still keeping the game balanced. 

Various mods to help with performance.
